Criteria for Collecting Papers: We collected over 150
papers related to Foundation Models for Recommender
Systems. Initially, we searched top-tier conferences and
journals such as ICLR, NeurIPS, WWW, WSDM, SIGIR,
KDD, ACL, EMNLP , NAACL, RecSys, CIKM, TOIS, TORS,
and TKDE to identify recent work. The primary keywords
used in our search included large language models for
recommender systems, generative recommendation, large
language models, multi-modal recommendation, and agents
for recommendation.
Contributions of This Survey: The aim of this survey is
to conduct a thorough review of the advancements in Foun-
dation Models for Recommender Systems (FM4RecSys). It
offers a comprehensive overview that enables readers to
quickly grasp and engage with the field of foundation
model-based recommendations. This survey establishes the
groundwork to encourage innovation in RSs and explore the
depth of this research domain. It is intended for researchers
and practitioners interested in RSs, providing them with a
guide for selecting FMs to address recommendation tasks. In
